rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for emotional comfort or reassurance that dispels worry.

example.english: What you said was a real source of reassurance to me.

rows.note: Use this for the resulting feeling of security or restored confidence rather than for the reassuring words themselves.

example.english: Moving to a building with controlled access gave me more reassurance.

rows.note: Use this when the reassurance is an explicit assurance, promise, or confirmation from someone.

example.english: Your reassurance that you would definitely save me a place put me at ease.
